accepted_answers.name: pydantic-settings
accepted_answers.why: Modern standard for layered config: env + dotenv + defaults with type validation, nested models, and secrets support.

accepted_answers.name: dynaconf
accepted_answers.why: Accepted alternative with deep layering (settings files, vaults, multiple envs) for apps that outgrow pydantic-settings.

notes: Strong consensus for new projects. Hand-rolled os.environ-plus-dict merging misses type coercion, validation errors, and precedence bugs.
problem: Loading layered configuration (environment + config file + defaults) in Python with ad-hoc merging code.
